## Squad: APEXlang tools (Oracle apexctl) Backend for the **Validate_App**, **Valid_Props**, **Example** and **Install_App** agent tools in the Squad sub-workflows and the Orchestrator. - validate: copies the session app to apexlang-skill/.tmp-validate/ and runs `apexctl apexlang format --strict-structure` + `compiler-truth audit --verify-component-attributes` (Oracle's own validator; format rewrites files, hence the copy). - props: `tools/query-valid-props.mjs --component [--parent

]` -- real property names from Oracle compiler metadata. - example: `scripts/squad-examples.mjs get ` -- Oracle's own example code from apexlang-skill/templates/. - install / reinstall: `scripts/squad-install.mjs` -- SQLcl on the connection in squad-install.config.json: runs the app's supporting-objects/*.sql, then `apex validate` + `apex import`. reinstall = even when no file changed. Requires NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=fs,path,child_process.
